phases.name: tool-calling
phases.gate: Python fluency — typed Python, uv, pytest, pydantic, async.
phases.build: One script. One model call. One tool with a real side effect — hits an API, writes a file, queries a database. No framework.
phases.verify: The tool fires with correct arguments; you see the effect.
phases.wall: Arguments don't validate; the script crashes.
phases.earned: The schema is a contract and the model is an unreliable client. Validation, and feeding errors back into the loop rather than throwing.
breaks: Request a call whose argument the model cannot know
Required enum + a request matching no value

phases.name: the-loop
phases.build: While-loop over a message list. Tool results appended. Stop condition. ~100 lines, no framework. Then three real tools, pointed at an actual recurring annoyance in your own work.
phases.verify: It completes a task you would otherwise do by hand. Then use it daily for a week — that week is part of the deliverable.
phases.wall: Works at step 3, degrades by step 15, and you can't see why. Killing it loses everything.
phases.earned: Trajectory logging (just enough to debug). Context accumulation as root cause. Checkpointing. The real lesson: an agent is a stateful long-running job, not a function call.

phases.name: search
phases.build: BM25 from scratch over your own documents — Arabic, ideally. Inverted index, term weighting, no retrieval libraries. Then wire it in as a tool the phase-02 agent calls.
phases.verify: Type a query, judge results by eye. Feedback in seconds.
phases.wall: Results are bad on some queries and you cannot tell whether the cause is chunking, tokenisation, or ranking.
phases.earned: recall@k and a golden set, bootstrapped from documents whose answers you already know. Then embeddings and hybrid fusion — added *to* BM25 and measured against it, never replacing it blind.
breaks: A query whose answer exists but ranks 40th
A document that should never match but does
Arabic queries using different morphological forms of one root

phases.name: serving
phases.gate: Linux + SSH + Docker + nvidia-smi. Rent the GPU before reading anything.
phases.build: Serve an open-weights model with vLLM. Point a minimal gateway at both it and the hosted API. Route your own tasks through both.
phases.verify: tokens/sec, cost per task, quality on your tasks. Numbers you generated yourself.
phases.wall: You can't predict when it will OOM, and can't explain why throughput scales with batching while latency doesn't.
phases.earned: KV-cache arithmetic. Paged attention. Continuous batching. Memory-bound decode vs compute-bound prefill.
breaks: Raise context length until it OOMs differently
Run a quantised variant and hunt for degradation on your tasks

phases.name: reassess
phases.build: Not a build phase. Four working systems exist; pick a direction by pull, not by plan. Candidates: agent reliability and durability · retrieval quality · inference performance · Arabic-specific model behaviour.
phases.verify: One paragraph in README.md naming the direction and why. Then a new phase spec written to §3.
